Sam / Naomi — looping in pricing detail and support-band options from our side. Below are three configurable options we commonly use for private/VPC deals — each assumes a minimum 12-month base term unless otherwise noted:

Option A — Fixed Commit (simplest)
- 12 mo commit: platform fee = $150k/yr; capacity metered (per-GPU-hour) with standard tier pricing; no volume credits.
- 24 mo commit: platform fee amortized -> effective $120k/yr (20% reduction) if paid annually; additional 5% rebate applied on metered spend if sustained monthly volumes > X tokens.
- 36 mo commit: effective $105k/yr (30% reduction) + 10% volume rebate at highest band.

Option B — Hybrid (platform credit + metered)
- Lower upfront platform fee (70% of standard) + committed monthly token floors. Unused committed tokens roll as credits up to a 3-mo window. Volume incentives scale at 500M/1B/2B token thresholds.

Option C — Enterprise reserved capacity (preferred for predictable high-volume)
- Reserved GPU pool with flat monthly charge. Platform fee waived for multi-year reserved capacity > N GPUs; long-term pricing includes preferred on-call support (24/7) at no extra charge for 36+ mo commits.

Support tiers (summary):
- Standard: business-hours support, 12x5, response SLA P3 = 4 hours.
- Premium: 24x7 on-call with guaranteed paging for Sev1/Sev2, up to 2 named on-call rotations, onboarding runbook included.
- Managed: fully-managed ops for on-prem with SOW; includes quarterly performance reviews and quarterly model tuning credits.

SOW: sample attached — covers deployment, runbook handoff, and 2 weeks of hypercare.

We can model effective TCO for Acme if you share expected monthly token profile (rough buckets are fine). From a negotiation perspective we typically protect: (a) minimum commit term for deep platform-fee discounts, and (b) a small early-exit fee to recover one-time onboarding costs if the customer exits before term.

[Attachment: SOW_PrivateDeployment_Sample_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Adding a pragmatic counter-proposal we can move to legal with — aim is to keep the platform-fee protection while giving Acme near-term flexibility:

Proposed commercial (for negotiation)
- Term: 24 months
- Platform fee: $135k/yr (amortized if paid annually) with a 12% volume rebate applied at >750M tokens/mo sustained for 3 consecutive months.
- Volume bands: 0–499M / 500M–749M / 750M+ tokens — rebates = 0% / 6% / 12% respectively on metered token spend.
- Burstable capacity credit: allow 10% monthly burst (tokens) without extra charge; sustained bursts billed at the next band.
- Support: Premium for year 1 (included), then option to renew at the standard premium rate or convert to Standard.
- Early-exit: prorated onboarding recovery = one month platform fee if canceled before 12 months.

Notes: this structure protects Redwood from heavy short-term bursts while giving Acme a clear path to savings as usage stabilizes. If procurement needs a longer lock (36 mo) we can push to 18% rebate at the top band and consider waiving the onboarding recovery fee.

If this looks acceptable, we should produce a one-page commercial summary and a redlineable SOW for legal.

-rishi
